# monotaur_variable (Resource)

Manages a Monotaur variable. Variables are named key-value pairs that can optionally be associated with a monitor.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "monotaur_variable" "threshold" {
  name        = "response_time_threshold"
  value       = "500"
  description = "Maximum acceptable response time in milliseconds"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the variable.
- `value` (String) The value of the variable.

### Optional

- `description` (String) An optional description of the variable.
- `monitor_id` (String) The ID of the monitor this variable belongs to (optional).

### Read-Only

- `create_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the variable was created (assigned by the API).
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the variable (assigned by the API).
- `update_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the variable was last updated (assigned by the API).
